Question Choices: Select. A train travels 90 km in 1 hour. What is the rate of travel? : 1hour-per-90km 90km-per-hour 45km-per-hour
Hints: Rate = amount per something (per hour, per item, etc.)
Solution: Distance = 90 km. Time = 1 hour. Rate = 90 ÷ 1 = 90 km per hour

Question Choices: A gardener plants 54 flowers in 6 hours. How many flowers can the gardener plant in 3 hours?
Hints: Step 1: Find flowers per hour. Step 2: Multiply by hours
Solution: Flowers per hour = 54 ÷ 6 = 9. In 3 hours: 9 x 3 = 27

Question Choices: 6 notebooks cost 15 dollars. How much (dollars) do 4 notebooks cost?

Solution: Price per notebook = 15 ÷ 6 = 2.5. 4 notebooks = 4 x 2.5 = 10 dollars
